lines.en: I push ahead segment after segment.
The little shards inside me click.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底的沙往前挪。
lines.en: I drag myself over the sandy floor.

lines.zh: 这段海沟太窄，我挤过去。
lines.en: This trench is narrow; I squeeze through.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先动，头才跟上。
lines.en: My tail moves first, then my head.
The current pushed me crooked.
I leave a shallow groove behind.
My shell is soft, so I go slow.
I crawl around the coral toward warm water.

lines.zh: 每挪一步，碎片就磨一下。
lines.en: Every inch grinds the shards in me.
In a storm, even the seafloor is loud.

lines.zh: 我顺着礁石的缝往上爬。
lines.en: I climb up a crack in the reef.
I am small, but I am already growing.

lines.zh: 沙里有东西，我停下来拱。
lines.en: Something is in the sand; I stop to dig.

lines.zh: 雷声还在上面滚，我趁着走。
lines.en: Thunder still rolls above. I move while it lasts.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉长，钻过那道缝。
lines.en: I stretch my body thin and slip through the gap.

lines.zh: 碎壳划过沙，声音像磨刀。
lines.en: My shell grits the sand like a whetstone.

lines.zh: 前面有光闪了一下，我停住。
lines.en: A flash of light ahead. I stop.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，又忘了要什么。
lines.en: I open my mouth and forget why.

lines.zh: 身体里的海晶慢慢转了一下。
lines.en: A prismarine shard turns slowly inside me.

lines.zh: 我摊在礁石上，像块烂肉。
lines.en: I sprawl on the rock like rotten meat.
Was that lightning just now?
I try to curl up and fail.

lines.zh: 我用一节身体敲了敲壳。
lines.en: I tap my shell with one segment.

lines.zh: 有点痒，我把身子扭了扭。
lines.en: Something itches; I twist my body.
I still remember being a fish.

lines.zh: 海水从两边的孔流过去。
lines.en: Water flows through the holes on my sides.
I sit with my mouth open a long while.
The shards have grown a little.

lines.zh: 我咬住一块珊瑚，没咬动。
lines.en: I bite the coral and get nothing.

lines.zh: 雷声从很远的地方滚过来。
lines.en: Thunder rolls in from very far away.

lines.zh: 我等着壳里再长出碎片。
lines.en: I am waiting for my shards to fill in.
You are bigger than any fish I knew.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，也能看见你。
lines.en: No eyes at all, and I still see you.
There is something bright about you.

lines.zh: 你潜水下来，是为了找我吗？
lines.en: Did you dive down looking for me?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，慢慢张大嘴。
lines.en: I look up and slowly open my mouth.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进我的沙里了。
lines.en: Your boots have stepped into my sand.
I keep to the dark under you.
Your breathing is very loud down here.
I know that iron shell you wear.

lines.zh: 你停住，我也把身子停住。
lines.en: You freeze, and I freeze with you.
A split opens along my soft shell.
The shards inside me are all jumbled.
It hurts; I shrink to one segment.
You crushed my back.

lines.zh: 我流出来的东西是亮的。
lines.en: What leaks out of me shines.
I am small and cannot take hits.
That blow stopped my crawling.
My mouth will not shut anymore.
You hit me. I will remember.
One more and I come apart.
That is prismarine. Give it here.
I do not eat fish. I eat hard things.
The piece in your hand is shining.
Let me bite it. Just once.
My shards want to grow one more.

lines.zh: 你拿贝壳逗我，我很生气。
lines.en: Teasing me with a shell is unwise.
Bright things make me hungry.
I can smell the salt inside that stone.
For now I will not eat you.
Put the crystal down and leave.

lines.zh: 你挤到我了，我的壳很软。
lines.en: You squeezed me; my shell is soft.
Did the shards cut your hand?

lines.zh: 抬脚，我的壳就在你靴下。
lines.en: Watch your step; I am right below it.
I rolled half over and cannot right myself.

lines.zh: 你踢我一下，我黏你靴上。
lines.en: Kick me once and I stick to your boot.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，都是湿的。
lines.en: We bumped. Both of us are wet.
Move over; this crack fits only one.
My slime is all over your legs.

lines.zh: 你撞得不重，我还没长硬。
lines.en: You barely hit me; I am not hard yet.

lines.zh: 我又缩回石头缝里去了。
lines.en: I have shrunk back into the rock.
We were both born in this storm.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的壳，听里面响。
lines.en: I press against your shell and listen.
You are young, and I am unfinished.
Let us wait until this rain passes.

lines.zh: 我用身体碰了碰你的身体。
lines.en: I touch your body with my body.
Our kind is scarce in this sea.

lines.zh: 两条幼虫缩进同一条石缝。
lines.en: We crowd into the same rock crack.
No rush; my shards are not complete.
Climb with me toward the warm current.
The shards scrape, very softly.

lines.zh: 这块海晶，我塞进身体里。
lines.en: This prismarine goes inside me.
I pick up the shard; it hurts.
Whatever sinks down here is mine.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，慢慢化。
lines.en: I keep it in my mouth until it melts.
I push along the iron bit you dropped.

lines.zh: 太沉，我这副软嘴拖不动。
lines.en: Too heavy for my soft mouth.

lines.zh: 这块和身体里的一样亮。
lines.en: This piece shines like the ones inside me.
I scoop it up and drop it again.
Let go. That broken shard is mine.
I hide in the crack and eat slowly.
You moved, so I followed.

lines.zh: 我闻到你血里的一点咸。
lines.en: I smell a little salt in your blood.
This patch of sand is my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 你个头大，我的牙也不小。
lines.en: Bigger than I am, and still I bite.

lines.zh: 我把嘴凑过去，一点一点。
lines.en: I edge my open mouth nearer.
There is something warm in you.
I hug the floor and crawl toward you.

lines.zh: 你踢起沙，挡住了我的眼。
lines.en: You kicked up sand and blinded me.
I fasten onto your ankle.
Do not swim far; I can keep up.
Under the sand I wait for your step.
I show only a little of my shell.

lines.zh: 你踩的那一步，我算好了。
lines.en: I counted the step you are about to take.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，从沙里等很久了。
lines.en: My mouth has stayed open in the sand.

lines.zh: 你听见很轻的摩擦声了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that light scraping?
I know these stones better than you.
One more step and you reach me.

lines.zh: 海流会把我的气味带走。
lines.en: The current will carry my scent off.
I am counting how many steps remain.
When you turn, I have already stopped.
My teeth are in and stay there.
I throw my whole body at your leg.
My shards will cut through.
Shake all you want; I hold on.
I bite and bore inward at once.
This bite is heavier than it looks.
Your hide is thicker than a fish's.
My mouth is full of iron taste.
Do not shout; the water will pour in.
I want one more piece of you.

lines.zh: 雷雨落下来，我从沙里出来。
lines.en: Storm rain falls and I climb from the sand.

lines.zh: 这片海，今晚多了一只幼虫。
lines.en: This sea has one more larva tonight.
I came out before I was finished.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚的裂缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the coral.
The water turned cold for a moment. That was me.

lines.zh: 我身上的碎片开始发亮。
lines.en: The shards in my body begin to shine.
The sand on the seafloor shifted.
In the rain-sound, I open my mouth.
Small and hungry, and that suits me.
Do not fear. First, I am only a worm.

lines.zh: 火太烫，我的黏液在冒泡。
lines.en: Too hot; my slime starts to bubble.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，壳更软了。
lines.en: I land on stone and my shell softens.

lines.zh: 我在水里长大，竟然会窒息。
lines.en: I grew up in water and cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 炸得我身体里的碎片都飞了。
lines.en: The blast throws the shards out of me.
The arrow went through my soft flesh.
Light turns inside my shell, and it hurts.
I am so hungry I bite the stones.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，碎片全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me; every shard lights up.
Below there is not water but emptiness.
